'''Michael Mendoza''' (also published as '''Michael David Mendoza''')<ref name="dt-14582">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14582 Hunt Down Fake Down (a k a  FlOps)], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 14 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14582/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14582/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Longshot''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in March 2001. Michael Mendoza also posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list in 1998.<ref name="list-63513">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/63513.html? swccg-discussion message #63513], Michael David Mendoza (1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000108045202/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/63513.html? Internet Archive]</ref>
